purpose: Test whether existing pretrained body parts can separate people inside mixed rectangles. No trajectory modification, GT creation, threshold sweep, or outcome prediction.
crop_rationale: Exactly double the previously used half-resolution court crop and far_court tile. Independent outputs retained; no scale-based winner selected.
threshold_source: Retained pose scripts: conf0.25,IoU0.7,imgsz1920,matchIoU0.5,keypoint0.5,cropedge4px at half resolution.
association: Per-frame exact maximum-IoU one-to-one matching to immutable native player rectangles, unmatched dummy weight0.5. Dynamic programming verified against100 exhaustive small cases. Matching is not verified identity.
visibility_warning: A confident keypoint may be hallucinated or belong to another overlapping person. Neither ankle confidence nor output availability certifies ground contact.
